title: Missing Default derive on FragmentSender when it has a natural initial state
description:
Line 431-438: `FragmentSender` could benefit from documenting why it cannot have Default (requires payload reference), but the missing doc comment leaves this implicit.

More importantly, line 725: `ReceiverResult` has `Default` but `SenderOutput` at line 414 does not, even though `SenderOutput::None` is a natural default.

Suggested fix: Add `#[derive(Default)]` to `SenderOutput` with `#[default]` attribute on `None` variant:
```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SenderOutput {
    #[default]
    None,
    ...
}
```
